entities.summary: Robert Ingemar Nordmark is a Swedish former professional ice hockey player. He was the head coach for Almtuna IS in Allsvenskan in the 2007–08 season, but he was replaced by Leif Boork in November 2007 because of poor results. He is a European scout of the Toronto Maple Leafs and used to be a European scout for the Edmonton Oilers. Nordmark is a cousin of former athlete Kenth Eldebrink and former ice hockey defenceman Anders Eldebrink.
